item.title: Gunsmoke - Malachi
item.description: Town drunk Malachi Harper poses as marshal just to impress his brother.

item.title: The Big Valley - Ambush
item.description: Victoria and a reluctant Simon Carter are the only protection three Yaqui indian women have from a group of bounty-seeking scalp hunters.

item.title: Wagon Train - The Mary Halstead Story
item.description: Mary Halstead joins the wagon train to search for the son she deserted years before. Could a wounded young man picked up by the train be him?

item.title: The Wild Wild West - The Night of the Inferno
item.description: Jim is set up as a renegade as a cover for him and Artie to sneak into Texas and track down General Juan Manolo, who is trying to take over the region.

item.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Neapolitan Mouse, The Field Mouse, Duck Doctor
item.description: "Tom and Jerry are touring through Naples and they encounter an Italian mouse., A lazy field mouse proves his worth to his grandfather by rescuing him from a thresher., Hunting in the woods, Tom wounds a duckling, little Quacker, who is doctored by Jerry."

item.title: Popeye and Pals - Shuteye Popeye, More Pep, Never Sock a Baby, Nearlyweds
item.description: "Popeye's snoring is keeping his resident mouse awake., Max draws Betty and Pudgy out of the inkwell., After Popeye punishes Swee'pea, the little guy runs away., Popeye and Bluto both plan to marry Olive Oyl."

item.title: The Beverly Hillbillies - The Bank Raising
item.description: Jed gets invited to the opening of Drysdale’s new Commerce Bank building. Granny thinks that he will actually be building the bank. Jed attends the party and meets two of Drysdale friends, who think he is a market wizard. When Jed is told he is helping to build the bank, he heads home to get tools and pick up Elly and Granny to help out. When they get there, they cause a bit of a disturbance and misunderstand what is going on.

item.title: The Beverly Hillbillies - Another Neighbor
item.description: Countess Maria comes to Beverly Hills, making Mrs. Drysdale very excited. But she wants to keep the countess away from the hillbillies. However, it's spring tonic time, and Granny passes it around the neighborhood, including at Countess Maria's house. She falls in love with the brew and visits the Clampetts. They become friends instantly. She starts falling for Jed, and has plans to marry her 6th husband, hoping it is an American.
